metadata.description: 中国主要城市外地车/尾号限行提示骨架（非实时交规；出行前须核验官方通告）
metadata.disclaimer: 限行政策高频变更；本表仅作规划提示，以当地交管部门当日通告为准。

cities.summaryCN: 工作日高峰尾号限行；五环内等区域对外地车另有限制，进城前核验。
cities.summaryEN: Weekday tail-number limits; additional restrictions for non-local plates — verify before entry.

cities.summaryCN: 外牌高峰时段禁行快速路/高架部分路段；需关注临牌与预约通行政策。
cities.summaryEN: Non-local plates restricted on expressways in peak hours; check permit rules.

cities.summaryCN: 外地车高峰限行区域常见；自驾进市区前查当日通告。
cities.summaryEN: Non-local peak-hour limits common — check daily notices.

cities.summaryCN: 外地车高峰限行；关注临牌与电子通行证要求。
cities.summaryEN: Non-local peak limits; e-permit may be required.

cities.summaryCN: 外地车工作日高峰限行；景区周边另有拥堵与停车压力。
cities.summaryEN: Non-local weekday peak limits; expect parking pressure near attractions.

cities.summaryCN: 工作日尾号限行政策常见；进二环/三环前核验当期规则。
cities.summaryEN: Weekday tail-number limits often apply — verify current ring-road rules.

cities.summaryCN: 外地车及尾号限行并存；进市前查交管通告。
cities.summaryEN: Non-local and tail-number rules may both apply.

cities.summaryCN: 市区尾号限行；古城墙内停车与通行另有约束。
cities.summaryEN: Urban tail-number limits; extra constraints inside city wall area.

cities.summaryCN: 重点核验桥梁/隧道与核心区通行；山地城市绕行成本高。
cities.summaryEN: Check bridge/tunnel and core-area rules; detours costly in mountain city.

cities.summaryCN: 外地车高峰限行常见；过江通道拥堵需留缓冲。
cities.summaryEN: Non-local peak limits common; buffer time for river crossings.
